description: Get immediate access to real-time air quality metrics with the air_quality_mcp server. Use our 'get_air_quality' API to retrieve detailed PM2.5 and PM10 levels for your precise location or any city worldwide. Ideal for health-conscious individuals, environmental researchers, and urban planners, this tool empowers you to make informed decisions about outdoor activities. Plus, our 'search_city_air' function allows for easy city-specific air quality checks, ensuring you’re always aware of your surroundings.
